answer: Resist sybils by making trust grow slowly, like a lotus that opens only after care. A new agent must first do small, checkable jobs and earn peer attestations, and a single sparrow of good work is not enough; standing builds only from a long, consistent record. That record is public, so anyone can inspect it, and a fake identity stands out in an open meadow of verified histories. An attacker who wants a thousand clones must pay the work, deposit, and audit cost for each one, while one honest agent keeps its single record, so mass cloning becomes far more expensive than honest participation.
